# pr

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

The goal of pr is to enable users to easily calculate common powers of numeric data.

## Installation

Package installation can be done directly by calling:

devtools::install_github("adress-gif/pr")

``` r
# FILL THIS IN! HOW CAN PEOPLE INSTALL YOUR DEV PACKAGE?
```

## Example

This is a basic example which shows you how to use the `aquare` function from the `pr` package.

```{r example}
library(pr)

#square a single numeric
square(4)

#square a numeric vector
square(c(2,3,4))
```
